notes.title: The song from teaser is out!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Since the announcement, we've received numerous requests to release the song from the teaser.
Well, we're happy to announce that the track is finally out! I won’t distract you from diving into the depths of Russian melancholy — just hit play and enjoy!

[url=https://youtu.be/DEd1uejSvjc]Youtube[/url]
[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kLeaMJZQZ0AvTabHyV3Hb87i_YVKeJl_/view?usp=sharing]Audio-file[/url]

The official release on streaming platforms will happen a bit later, but we just couldn’t keep you waiting any longer. 🙂

Have a great day!
